description.narrative: L'intervention vise à redynamiser et à mobiliser les Comités de protection des enfants (CPE) en tant qu¿acteurs incontournables dans la protection et la promotion des droits de l¿enfant au Burundi, tout en renforçant leur collaboration avec les autres acteurs communautaires oeuvrant pour la protection et la promotion des droits des enfants notamment les OBC, OSC y compris les OPH, les leaders communautaires, les leaders religieux, afin de contribuer à l¿émergence d¿une société burundaise plus équitable, plus juste et plus respectueuse envers les enfants y compris les enfants à besoins spécifiques.

description.narrative: As of October 2021, SDG indicator 5.2.2 is a Tier II indicator please check data availability for your country of interest before selecting this indicator. If SDG data is not publicly available, baseline and endline surveys would need to be conducted and budgeted by the EUfunded intervention.According to the UN Declaration on the Elimination of Violence against Women (1993), Violence against Women is Any act of genderbased violence that results in, or is likely to result in, physical, Sexual or psychological harm or suffering to women, including threats of such acts, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life. Violence against women shall be understood to encompass, but not be limited to, the following: Physical, Sexual and psychological violence occurring in the family .
